metadata.title: जिंदगी से भागता पहाड़ी कोरवा आदिवासी । The Survival of Hill Korwa Tribe । Main Bhi Bharat
metadata.description:
The Hill Korwa is a primitive Tribe in the state of Chhattisgarh. This tribe is classified as PVTG (Particularly Vulnerable Tribe) by the government of India. The Hill Korwa or Pahari Korwas were hunter gatherers but were persuaded to settle down in permanent habitations inside the jungle. The government of India gave them land for cultivation, to help earn a livelihood. But these tribal people are not interested in cultivation, and to a certain extent still follow the lifestyle of hunter gatherers only.
In this episode, we take you to one of the hamlets of this tribe, and show their intriguing story.
